verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents a first-party Organizations feature: an admin-console section for creating and managing organizations within a realm (kc-supp-orgs). Separately, it describes realms as isolated tenants (keycloak-docs-20). That covers the core multi-tenant B2B modeling, but the evidence only shows creating an organization with a name; membership management and invitation flows are not documented in the pack. Missing for 10: documented organization membership management, invitation flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the organizations feature.
